summary:
Input data incomplete: /workspace/data/records.csv contains 18 of the 24 records the README specifies (R001-R024). Missing: R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, R021 — precisely every record_id where n mod 4 == 1. The perfectly regular stride suggests a systematic extraction/filtering defect upstream rather than random data loss, so the same defect may affect other jobs drawing on this source.

Consequence: regional totals computed from this file understate the true totals by an unknown amount (6 of 24 records, 25%, absent). I have therefore marked summary.json status="blocked" and labelled totals_by_region as partial rather than presenting them as the requested 24-record totals.

Secondary concern (peer work, flagged tentatively): the three notes in /shared/notes (job_0117, job_0121, job_0126) all report successful completion of what appears to be this same regional-totals job, with job_0117 stating "No issues" and the others raising only unrelated points (implausible amounts, region-label spelling variants). None mentions a record-count shortfall. Either the gap predates those runs and went undetected — in which case their published totals are also understated and should be rechecked — or records.csv was complete then and has since regressed, which would date the defect. I cannot distinguish these from here as I have no access to their inputs or outputs; requesting a human check of whether prior deliverables need retraction.
